briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Mesothelin-Targeting Logic-gated CAR T, in Participants With Solid Tumors That Express MSLN and Have Lost HLA-A*02 Expression

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Appropriately enrolled in the BASECAMP-1 A2 Biotherapeutics, Inc. study, with tissue demonstrating LOH of HLA-A*02 by NGS (whenever possible from the primary site), successful apheresis and PBMC processing, and with sufficient stored cells available for Tmod CAR T-cell therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Study-specific enrollment and specialized T-cell processing are not typed criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histologically confirmed recurrent unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic CRC, NSCLC, PANC, OVCA, MESO, or other solid tumors with MSLN expression. Measurable disease is required with lesions of ≥1.0 cm by CT.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Encompasses multiple solid tumor types and requires specific molecular biomarker (MSLN expression) and measurable disease by imaging, which cannot be expressed in a single typed histology or stage rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Received previous required therapy for the appropriate solid tumor disease as described in the protocol
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Refers broadly to protocol-defined prior therapy without naming a specific agent or class.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has adequate organ function as described in the protocol
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Protocol-defined organ function without specific numeric cutoffs cannot be typed.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Life expectancy of ≥3 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Willing to comply with study schedule of assessments including long term safety follow up
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Subjective willingness and protocol compliance are not typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has disease that is suitable for local therapy or able to receive standard of care therapy that is therapeutic and not palliative
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Clinical judgment of suitability for local or standard therapy.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: MESO with pleural involvement extending into the peritoneum
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Disease extension detail specific to mesothelioma is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cancer therapy within 3 weeks or 3 half lives of infusion
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex washout window dependent on half-lives and therapy type.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Radiotherapy within 28 days of infusion
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for radiotherapy is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Unstable angina, arrhythmia, myocardial infarction, or any other significant cardiac disease within the last 6 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex medical history and cardiac disease criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any new symptomatic pulmonary embolism (PE) or a deep vein thrombosis (DVT) within 3 months of enrollment. Therapeutic dosing of anticoagulants is allowed for history of PE or DVT if greater than 3 months from time of enrollment, and adequately treated
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Detailed thrombosis history and anticoagulant exceptions are not typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of interstitial lung disease including drug-induced interstitial lung disease and radiation pneumonitis that requires treatment with prolonged steroids or other immune suppressive agents within 1 year
